item.risk_statement: Evidence or an attestation could be represented as truth or proof of a correct outcome.
item.required_control: Require limitations, forbidden-claim tests and review of every public wording surface.

item.risk_statement: A verification result could be represented as permission or operational authorization.
item.required_control: Require non-elevation language, a separate decision reference and a negative case.

item.risk_statement: An attestation could be marketed as a certificate or as a certified Agent.
item.required_control: Ban certificate claims until an independent authorized certification system exists.

item.risk_statement: Schema validity or a conformance result could be presented as production proof.
item.required_control: Publish exact maturity, scope, executed count, limitations and a production-claim prohibition.

item.risk_statement: Partial or sampled observations could be presented as a complete execution history.
item.required_control: Propagate completeness, sampling, drop, partial and unknown status without silent fill.

item.risk_statement: VEAP could become a second canonical owner for DBOS, EEOAP or verifier objects.
item.required_control: Enforce the ownership crosswalk, opaque references and conflict fail-closed semantics.

item.risk_statement: A SAEE evaluation or recommendation could be converted into decision or execution.
item.required_control: Keep advisory labels, require separate decision and authorization, and prohibit writeback.
